mechanism.summary: Stacked on wide-tier-interpreter-exits and planned from the same queue for a batched promotion. The wide tier runs guarded Math unary calls as resolved calls whose call path answers the interpreter's own guard, admits compiler-built thunks (class field initializers) that have no parameters and no FunctionPrologueEnd, treats FreshIterationScope as the no-op it is for a body without closures, and exits only at the backward edges of loops an accelerator claims (fusion-lowered loops run natively). Plan written after exploratory screens; the target is the queue opportunity the CF trace ties to these declines.
mechanism.generality: Every class with public field initializers calls one thunk per field per construction; corpus CF traces counted 179k general-path frames for them and 270k for guarded Math calls. The Math path reuses math_unary, the interpreter's guard.
semantic_risks: A guarded Math call on a non-number or a replaced Math function must take the ordinary call
A field initializer's receiver and captured class binding must be the construction's
Per-iteration let bindings must still be fresh when a closure could capture them

profile_evidence.shared_cost: Exact queue-candidate binary, one-second sample of the official bundle. QJS_CF_TRACE on the same source counts 179k general-path frames for two-instruction field-initializer thunks declined for lacking FunctionPrologueEnd, and 61k for bodies declined at FreshIterationScope.
